title: Python early contributor Tim Peters dies at 74
summary: Guido van Rossum announced that Tim Peters, an early Python contributor, has died at 74. Peters wrote Timsort, the sorting algorithm that carries his name, and PEP 20, "The Zen of Python," and he served on the Python Software Foundation board for 13 years. The source describes him as Python&\#x27;s second real user; no cause of death was given.
